resolution_policy.note: Emit store/floor only when abstention policy and verified journeys pass gates.

zone_expected_note: expected_visits is probability mass summed over candidate posteriors (visitor stops), not a device count; zone geometry for non-pilot malls is approximate (Overture-derived).

counter_status.note: June unweighted vs weighted comparison is available; true counter reconciliation requires trusted entrance totals.

normalized_note: visitors_per_100k_panel divides each mall/day by island active panel devices that day, removing co-movement driven by panel growth; sdkapp_share gives daily source-mix context.

uncertainty.method: stratified (weekday/weekend) day bootstrap, B=200; core visitors (transit pass-through excluded); 95% percentile CI

leakage_note: leak_share = of this mall's visitors, the share who also visited the other mall in July; capture_of_other = share of the other mall's visitors we also hold. Share of observed visits across covered malls only — not market-wide share or proven switching.

audience.note: lift = mall share / baseline share across covered malls; modelled device attributes, not verified demographics.

hsmm_diagnostic.caveat: Diagnostic only: sampled devices, session-level sequences; HSMM did not outperform the independent baseline on the June synthetic tests. Do not use for published figures.
